security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://127.0.0.1:* https:

bundle.shortDescription: A friendly XMPP chat client, end-to-end encrypted.
bundle.longDescription: Hey Postie is a modern replacement for Pidgin: one-to-one chats and rooms, OMEMO encryption, files and images, reactions, system notifications, and the history of your server. XMPP only: it works with any XMPP server and with the other clients (Conversations, Gajim, Monal, Dino...). Free software.
